[[File:LukeSkywalker-CotF.jpg|thumb|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] wearing thermal gloves]]
'''Thermal gloves''' were used to keep hands warm on cold planets. They were issued to the Imperials stationed on the ice planet [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. In order to compensate for lost dexterity imposed by the gloves, [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] with over-sized keys were often issued in conjunction with them. They were also used by [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] as a part of their flight gear.
